reader_guide: Read the overall grade first, then the nine dimensions. The letter grades judge the code and tests visible in this checkout. The three risk grades identify behavior that source reading alone cannot settle. Each finding includes a short, verbatim source excerpt and a test that could disprove the concern. Severity describes the effect on the founder’s phone today, not the effort to fix it. The ranked refactor targets describe concrete changes; the roadmap orders changes that depend on one another. Read the strengths alongside the findings: the process split, single session owner, polish fallback, insertion tests, and privacy filters are substantial engineering work worth keeping. This is a read-only audit. No build, device run, network capture, or timing measurement was performed. The missing root CLAUDE.md in this checkout and the runtime checks are listed under not_assessed. Clean-install recovery, download-from-empty, and reinstall recovery belong to stage 2 and did not lower the grade. The September service and navigation extractions were measured as they exist now; their old sizes were not treated as current defects.

overall_grade.rationale: This is production-minded senior engineering, not AI slop. The single session owner, five-process isolation, first-wins decisions, outcome tests, and content-filtered diagnostics show deliberate design. The main defect is a pre-capture startup chain where optional preparation can wait without a deadline, potentially leaving a take in STARTING. Smaller risks sit in a polish binder fallback and the unbounded History queue. The coordinator is still large, but the service and navigation extractions are real.
overall_grade.confidence_rationale: The cited control flow is directly visible, but this read-only audit ran no build or S26 Ultra test. The checkout also lacks the requested root CLAUDE.md.

dimensions.name: Architecture integrity
dimensions.justification: The inventory puts the current mass in DictationSessionCoordinator.kt at 1,341 lines, AudioCaptureService.kt at 997, RecordingAccessibilityOverlay.kt at 817, and AccessibilityInsertionRunner.kt at 711. DictationSessionService.kt is 253 lines and AppShell.kt is 240. The coordinator owns the take, while the service and shell have been split. The coordinator still mixes session transitions with notice delivery and telemetry payload construction; those presentation and projection details could move to their existing owners. The concrete heart risk is that vocabulary compilation and polish policy loading precede capture without a deadline.

dimensions.name: Concurrency discipline
dimensions.justification: Capture commands have their own ordered lane, capture callbacks post to main, and the session scope has a service-owned job. The polish service nevertheless performs deterministic text preparation directly in several AIDL entry branches, including the poisoned-runtime branch. That branch can involve language detection on a binder thread.

best_example.why_exemplary: A binder callback hands the event to the owner thread and checks take identity there.

worst_violation.confidence_rationale: accept is called by the AIDL implementation and fallbackText invokes deterministic cleanup and language detection synchronously.
worst_violation.counterfactual: After a local polish timeout, a following request can occupy a polish binder thread doing text preparation before it receives its fallback.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The poisoned branch bypasses the service executor and computes fallbackText before delivering the callback.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Instrument the poisoned branch with a blocking fake language detector and assert that the AIDL call returns promptly while the fallback is completed on a worker.
worst_violation.concurrency_interleaving: 1. The deadline thread marks the polish process poisoned. 2. Before process exit, a binder thread enters accept for another request. 3. It takes the poisoned branch and calls fallbackText. 4. Language detection stalls on that binder thread. 5. The request callback waits until that work finishes or the process exits.

Sentry drops exception messages, and the logger renders exception classes and locations without messages. The startup deadline concern is counted under architecture and performance.

dimensions.name: API surface
dimensions.justification: The new take AIDL interface has five operations, while the legacy capture interface is retained for append-only compatibility. Top-level app visibility is mostly narrowed. The service action and extra constants remain public members even though command sending and the service are app-internal concerns.

best_example.why_exemplary: A take binds to the small operation set it actually needs.

worst_violation.confidence_rationale: These members use Kotlin's public default; the service must be public for Android construction, but its command constants need only app-module visibility.
worst_violation.counterfactual: Another module can compile against service command details that were meant to remain implementation details.

worst_violation.falsifiability: Change the constants to internal and compile the app and instrumentation clients; a required external reference would disprove the proposed narrowing.

dimensions.name: Performance and latency
dimensions.justification: The first-audio path has a 2-second settings-answer bound but no bound for subsequent matcher compilation or policy loading. This creates an unmeasured tail before the microphone binds. Capture levels and take status are pushed rather than polled; the recording picture is a custom view, so a Compose recomposition claim was not established. Physical timings and simultaneous model residency still need a phone trace.

best_example.why_exemplary: The hot read loop caps bytes and hands event delivery to another worker.

worst_violation.confidence_rationale: Both steps precede capture without a deadline; the actual tail on the S26 Ultra was not measured here.
worst_violation.counterfactual: Trigger-to-first-audio time can become arbitrarily long when policy storage stalls or term compilation grows.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: There is no timeout between the bounded settings answer and bindPipelineServices.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Time trigger-to-first-frame on the S26 Ultra while injecting a stalled policy read and a large term set; demonstrate a bounded fallback in both cases.
worst_violation.concurrency_interleaving: 1. START schedules preparation. 2. The settings read answers. 3. The preparation coroutine waits in matcher compilation or policy loading. 4. The main thread continues showing STARTING. 5. Audio binding is never reached until the preparation returns.

dimensions.name: Resource lifecycle
dimensions.justification: The Bluetooth hold has an explicit 30-second expiry, an idempotent close path, listener cleanup, and a stopped-writer watch. The application History queue has unlimited capacity and one worker. A stalled Room operation can leave later writes accumulating without an upper bound, although insertion itself proceeds. Phone testing is needed to measure queue behavior under a genuinely slow database.

best_example.why_exemplary: Ending the decided warm hold removes its timer, listeners, and route identity in one place.

worst_violation.rule_violated: Named engineering principle: background work queues need a finite capacity or explicit overload policy
worst_violation.confidence_rationale: The queue is unbounded and serial by inspection. Sustained database blocking and the resulting memory cost remain runtime scenarios.
worst_violation.counterfactual: If one History write remains blocked while dictation continues, later History rows stay pending and queued closures consume increasing memory.
worst_violation.counterfactual_rationale: The single worker cannot advance past a blocked write, while trySend keeps accepting into an unlimited channel.
worst_violation.falsifiability: Hold the repository's first write, enqueue repeated takes, and show a finite enforced queue limit or that later writes can progress without unbounded growth.
worst_violation.concurrency_interleaving: 1. The queue worker starts a Room write and stalls. 2. A take completes and enqueues more History writes. 3. Further takes enqueue again. 4. The one worker remains on the first write. 5. The unlimited channel retains the later writes until the stall ends or the process dies.

dimensions.name: Security and privacy
dimensions.justification: Audio is passed between app processes by file path, provider secrets use Android Keystore with encrypted app-private blobs, models are pinned and hash-verified, and clipboard restoration checks ownership. PostHog applies an allowlist and Sentry judges or clears text-bearing fields. GenieX logging is silenced before SDK initialization. Static reading cannot prove the final network payload or a vendor upgrade's logging behavior.

fun sanitize(event: SentryEvent): SentryEvent {
        event.serverName = null
        event.request = null
        event.user = null
        event.transaction = null
        event.setModules(null)
        event.setUnknown(null)
        event.platform = event.platform?.let(SentrySchema::identifier)
        event.logger = event.logger?.let(SentrySchema::identifier)
best_example.why_exemplary: The outgoing crash event loses user, request, and unknown fields before the remaining strings are judged.

refactor_targets.title: Bound preparation before capture
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Introduce a typed TakePreparation result. Put matcher compilation and policy loading behind one measured startup deadline, preserving the last compiled matcher and last successfully read policy. On timeout or ordinary exception, freeze the fallback values, record a defect, and continue to bindPipelineServices. Keep capture admission and the state transition in DictationSessionCoordinator.

refactor_targets.title: Keep fallback preparation off polish binder threads
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Make the null-policy, poisoned-runtime, and duplicate-id branches enqueue a fallback task on a service-owned worker. The AIDL method should return after admission; the worker runs fallbackText and then delivers the outcome once. Keep request identity and cancellation checks before callback delivery.

refactor_targets.title: Give History writes an overload result
refactor_targets.rule_violated: Named engineering principle: background work queues need a finite capacity or explicit overload policy
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Replace Channel.UNLIMITED with a finite per-process queue and a typed Accepted or Rejected enqueue result. Preserve write order for each row. Have the finalizer treat rejection as a failed History save, keep the words available through insertion or clipboard, and emit one content-free defect. Add a stalled-repository stress test.

refactor_targets.title: Trim the coordinator's presentation and telemetry work
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Move notice rendering and delivery calls into the existing SessionNoticePresenter. Move the mapping from polish reason and context to publication telemetry fields into a small TakeFacts projector. Leave the coordinator's reservation, terminal commit, and insertion decision in DictationSessionCoordinator; delete the moved code there in the same change.

refactor_targets.title: Test a policy read that never answers
refactor_targets.fix_shape: In the existing DictationSessionRig, supply a suspended loadPolicy that never completes. Assert a subject-fired capture or terminal signal within the startup budget, the chosen fallback policy, and one defect. Keep the current PolicyRead.Failed tests for reads that do answer.

refactor_targets.title: Correct the History completion comment
refactor_targets.rule_violated: Named engineering principle: comments must describe the current control flow
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Replace the claim that completion waits for the History save with the current rule: reserve and enqueue the save together, then commit and deliver without waiting. Keep the ordering explanation about teardown only if it still matches the tests.

refactor_targets.title: Narrow service command member visibility
refactor_targets.fix_shape: Mark the service action and extra companion constants internal. Keep DictationSessionService public for Android construction and keep the AIDL transactions unchanged.

phased_roadmap.title: Close immediate startup and binder risks
phased_roadmap.rationale: These changes have no dependencies. The startup bound protects the heart; the binder change protects a real failure branch. The two small corrections remove misleading or wider-than-needed API surface.

phased_roadmap.title: Make the failure contracts measurable
phased_roadmap.rationale: The startup outcome test pins REF-01. The History queue change requires an overload outcome and a stalled-writer test while preserving insertion.

phased_roadmap.title: Reduce coordinator mass
phased_roadmap.rationale: Move presentation and telemetry projection after the startup behavior is protected, while the coordinator remains the sole terminal decision maker.

strengths.pattern_name: Isolated capture, ASR, VAD, and polish services
strengths.why_preserve: Separate processes limit model memory and crash impact.
The target and terminal arbiter are assigned once at admission.
Disconnect, answer, and fallback cannot each publish their own result.
Expiry, listeners, and route bookkeeping have one close path.
A model is ready only after receipt, file shape, byte count, and hash checks.
Messages and user-supplied context are cleared or judged before sending.
The test checks the destination text and exactly-once result, not only that an action was called.

meta_recommendations.recommendation: Make the startup outcome test in REF-05 a gate for changes to session preparation.
On the S26 Ultra, record trigger-to-first-frame and stop-to-insertion timings with stalled policy storage and many custom terms.
Exercise a real Bluetooth take, its 30-second silent hold, handover, device removal, and teardown while observing route release and microphone state.

least_confident_finding.why_low_confidence: The coordinator is large, but session decisions belong there. Moving notice and telemetry projection may improve reading without improving a user outcome, and a careless split could obscure ownership.
least_confident_finding.what_would_resolve_it: Measure code review and change effort on the affected methods, then require an extraction that leaves terminal decisions and their outcome tests in the coordinator.

top_not_assessed_gap.gap: The full heart path under process loss and real editor focus changes on the founder’s S26 Ultra.
top_not_assessed_gap.runtime_test_required: Run a spoken take into a real third-party editor; kill or stall polish, then separately kill capture or ASR, move focus between fields, and verify the text, notice, clipboard, History row, and single terminal defect.
top_not_assessed_gap.why_this_matters_for_heart_limbs: Static fallback branches and unit fakes cannot prove that the customer receives their last successful text in the intended place, exactly once, when Android services and editor focus change.
